name: x-nav-to-geojson
source: latitude and longitude in degrees bind lat and lon; hae is altitude above mean sea level plus undulation (the module's derive add, engine-spec 0.16); the velocity is 5 m/s north and 0 east, so track's derives give course 0 (bearing) and speed_ms 5 (hypot); geojson writes [lon, lat, alt] (RFC 7946, engine-spec 0.1.1 rulings 3 to 5)
